summary: Verified BluBridge logo asset delivery bug fix on preview URL. Header wordmark /images/blubridge-wordmark.png, scrolled-state /images/b-icon.png, and footer wordmark all load as valid PNGs (content-type image/png; sizes 2622 and 1344 bytes matching /public/). Regression pass on header nav, /research hero + 3 papers, and /contact eyebrow removal all pass.

test_results.research_page_regression: PASS (H1 'Papers & Publications' present, '/ 03 ENTRIES' rendered once, 3 paper elements found)

critical_code_review_comments: The dual express.static (build/ then public/) fallback in /app/frontend/server.js is defensive and reasonable, but a healthier long-term fix is ensuring `yarn build` reliably copies /public/ (CRA does this by default; investigate why incremental builds skipped it). Consider adding a postbuild verification script that fails CI if /build/images/blubridge-wordmark.png is missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo delivery bug is fully resolved. Both /images/blubridge-wordmark.png (2622 bytes) and /images/b-icon.png (1344 bytes) serve as image/png from preview URL. Header/footer render logos with naturalWidth=147. Regression items (header nav, /research hero + timeline, /contact eyebrow removal) all still working. No further action needed for this fix.
rca of the issue: Bug was static asset delivery: CRA build occasionally not copying /public/images/* into /build/, so requests fell through to SPA catch-all serving index.html. Fix added express.static(public) fallback after express.static(build) — verified via curl and in-browser fetch that /images/*.png now return proper PNG bytes with content-type image/png.
